title: Improved sample complexity bound for sample-based Lindbladian simulation
summary: We establish improved sample-complexity bounds for sample-based Lindbladian simulation based on the Wave Matrix Lindbladization (WML) algorithm. For a jump operator $L$ with dimension $d$, we derive an explicit non-asymptotic sample complexity bound $n_d^*(t,\varepsilon) \le \left( \frac{2d+3}{8} \right) \|L\|_\infty^2 \left( \frac{t^2}{\varepsilon} \right)$, holding for simulation time $t$ and error $\varepsilon$. This refines the dimension dependence of the best previously known bound, $O(d^2 t^2/\varepsilon)$, from [Go et al., Quantum Sci. Tech. 10, 045058 (2025)]. Remarkably, we show…
